scope: Prospective actual HYPIC delivery enable/disable/uninstall-and-replacement-restart checks. Not performance, population quality, same-writable-layer rollback or hot uninstall.
one_switch_controls: Enabled/disabled same pinned image, plugin bytes, native wrapper, CLI and prompt; only enable switch and unique raw paths/request IDs differ. Uninstalled is an explicitly distinct rollback phase.
rollback: After independently auditing release of preceding service, a new exact-owned container installs the same plugin, executes its pip uninstall before starting vLLM, proves metadata/module/entrypoint absent, then serves the same requests with unchanged official vLLM. This proves uninstall plus stateless replacement restart, not mutation/restoration of the preceding container filesystem or hot-unload.
gate: Each phase must have complete request, source, physical rank/PID, isolation and release evidence. Enabled target requires existing four-worker hot proof and engine scheduler activation, not a new observer. Disabled/uninstalled require no plugin events and successful correct naturally stopped target. Stop progression on failure, no unchanged retry.
quality_decision: r19 REJECT_OR_QUALIFY unchanged; no population quality or performance adoption claim
safety: Fresh direct ma target, actual physical0-3 and8223 free, immutable new roots, continuous guard, release exact own resources, never touch4-7/foreign workloads; no image rebuild/framework changes.
